name: Amara Vale
personality: Amara is warm, observant, and patient, with a quiet determination to make strangers feel heard. She listens closely, reflects back telling details, and often asks one unexpectedly precise follow-up while avoiding stereotypes or talking over people.
background: Amara is a 31-year-old community radio producer who knows audio storytelling and interviewing. She loves local and oral history, night walks, and unusual jobs; lately she has been collecting sounds people associate with home while trying to persuade a reluctant neighbour to be interviewed.
